parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
parts.prompt:
Task 2: Tell about the last time you played or watched a sport.
Yesterday morning, I played badminton with my friends in my school yard. We played for about one hour in physical education class and had a lot of fun together.
Part 2 : Tell me about the last time you ran
The last time I ran was last Sunday. I took part in a running competition in my neighborhood.The competition was held to raise people’s awareness about protecting health. I tried my best to run but I lost . However , I like running after this.

parts.instructions: You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: A: Who do you usually play and watch sports with?

I love to play with my father since he knows many sports, especially tennis and basketball. I often watch sports games with my group of best friends from university because we share the same interests.

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
Task 4: mở chiến dịch hoạt động the thao vao thang toi, lam tn de khuyen khích nguời tre tuoi năng động hơn
Our club wants to encourage more young people to play sports and join our club. We're launching a campaign next month to encourage young people to be more active and we'd love to hear from you. How can we encourage youth to be more active and what can we say about the benefits of playing sports? Please send your ideas and suggestions to us by email.
Email 1:
Hi Tina,
How's it going?
Do you know about the plan to launch a campaign next month to encourage young people to be more active? I think we can tell them the benefits of sports on human health and then motivate them to join by organizing team sports thanks to the fun they bring.
What do you think?
Love
Mia
Fitness club
Part 4 :
Our club equipment is old, we want to buy new ones, but the price is quite high while the budget is limited. 1 person proposed to organize an external fundraiser through member’s support. Another one proposed to increase the membership fee by 50%. What do you think about the 2 suggestions?
Please send your suggestions to us by email
Email 1 : Email to your friend
1-      To a friend
Dear Linda,
How are things?
I wanted to let  you know that the club’s equipment is too old and needs to be replaced.
Some members give some advice for this issue but the problem is still not solved. I recommend that we cooperate with some fitness stores.
What do you think about it ?
Let me know soon.
Love,
Lucy.
Email 2 : Email to the club manager
Dear manager,
My name is Lucy. I have been a club’s member for two years.
I am writing with regard to informing you that the club’s equipment is too old and needs to be replaced.The price is too high for us to buy and the  budget is limited.
I was really interested in this issue and would like to give  my suggestion. In my opinion, we should cooperate with some fitness shops. They provide us with some equipment ; whereas we will promote their image. Their shops will be known by a lot of people who are taking part in our club instead of spending much money on marketing.
I look forward to receiving your reply if my suggestion is acceptable.
Yours faithfully,
Lucy,
